Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, to be carried out on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 
in the title block.
The generator data: 277MVA, 15.75KV, 10.173KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, 
tested by eng. Enas Azmy, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Saad Bassuony, accepted 
by eng. Aly Abdel Wahab general director, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head 
sector of Talkha PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.
The unit must be on service.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass etc
New brushes.
Digital voltmeter and clamp ammeter.
Work to be carried out
Inspect the brush vibration.
Inspect the sparking brushes.
Inspect brush holders and slip rings.
Replace the brush by a new one if its height falls to 25mm.
Record current and voltage value of generator as in MRDS and compare the 
 results with the standard value.
